relative_path_base: The directory supplied as --workspace/--root; preserve the listed directory layout.

requirements: Python 3.9 or newer with standard library (Path.is_relative_to is used); run without -O because stage and joint use assert as verification gates.
Package every listed input path, including duplicate-content files at distinct paths.
Package N601_INPUT_PINS.json and the audit markdown pinned by transport; neither is an optional report.
Original .mjs/.py producer files are read as text/hash evidence, so their imported runtimes and private construction helpers are not replay dependencies.
replay.warning: Replaying successor checks re-verifies source bindings and analytical application records; it does not rerun the original producer calculations or create a kernel proof.

portability.recommendation: Preserve relative layout. The parent added relocated_producer, which rebases the immutable audit paths under --root and rejects parent traversal. Original audit JSON and its pins remain unchanged.

selection_privacy_check.selection_basis: Only explicitly declared runtime input manifests and the three successor CLI entrypoints. No browser, download/upload, credential or session helper was selected.
selection_privacy_check.scope_limit: Known-token and credential-assignment pattern scan of exact bytes; not an exhaustive secret-detection guarantee. Original mathematical construction seals mentioned in source are not runtime credentials and are not executed.

material_mathematical_caveats.statement: Native angular/radial-axial comparisons are exact function identities on the original domain. Arbitrary fixed derivatives follow only after the independently authenticated primary and initialized-mean smoothness/majorants are applied; finite native derivative rows alone do not prove all orders.

Transport PASS is a conditional source application, with explicit P_PRIMARY/P_MEAN/P_SUPPORT/P_NATIVE/P_DOMAIN. The joint candidate must justify these using the recovered same-source theorem. It is not licensed to replace their status with PASS merely because transport checks passed.

All-q language requires the canonical compatible-prefix construction and one order-independent original threshold. The literal N=1 snapshot is restricted by b_2*q>=1; frozen finite-prefix checks alone do not cover all q.

Whole3 background scaling is exact: 2D+2h=1, velocity K^A, pressure K^(2A). The initialized whole commonY mean remains unchanged except inverse slow chart; it cannot be silently replaced by a local own-label mean or assumed to factor through xi/v.

G_wave W^(99997/100000) and Gaussian F_pulse are distinct. The +psi_prime*t tail is retained and physically flat to every fixed q order; it is not zero. The retained nonlinear P/J remainders likewise are bounded, not set to zero.

The mean all-order application uses radial IBP p=49001 and initial source order m+98005. This is finite for each fixed m and may use the all-order source theorem, but the exact telescoping and uniform-prefix bounds still warrant independent mathematical review.

The stage verifier proves a universal conservative operator identity and source dataflow. At the signed covariance stage the complete auxiliary pressure/direct/assembled construction is absent; Haar covariance does not recover discarded nonzero auxiliary modes. N6-02 and the full correction cycle remain open.

Neither source hash checks nor rational exponent arithmetic constitutes a new machine-checked analytical proof. Joint status remains a reviewable mathematical source-application candidate pending independent review; no promotion of historical N6-01 status or M3 count follows from packaging.
